line: Just ten seconds of your voice — from any video or voicemail online — is all AI needs to clone it now.
It can call someone you love, sound just like you, and ask for money.
It can even show up as your own phone on their screen — but the call isn't coming from your phone. It's spoofed.
Agree on a safe word in advance — AI can fake a voice, but not a word it doesn't know.
It won't stop the call from coming. It just can't fake a response it was never told.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
